overview_description.description: Belong is a location-based group app that allows local people to share, learn and gain knowledge on the topics they care most about. Whatever your interest, there is an organised and moderated community for you on ASKWHO. Belong is a social discovery platform designed to help people build meaningful local connections through shared interests, activities, and communities. The app enables users to discover events, join groups, and meet like-minded individuals nearby. Belong focuses on fostering real-world interactions and community engagement, creating a digital space that encourages friendships, networking, and social experiences in urban environments.
